title: First Lines
subtitle: Whan that Aprill with his shoures soote...
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Whan that Aprill with his shoures soote... — the opening of the Canterbury Tales. Read it aloud ten times, attending to every final -e. WHAHN thaht ah-PREEL with hiss SHOO-res SOH-tuh... The meter reveals the pronunciation.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand First Lines.
